notes: One program per (b,oc,od), loops over OH contiguous rows.
One program per (b,oc,od,oh), copies one contiguous OW row.
One program per (b,oc,od,ceil(oh/2)), loops over up to 2 contiguous OW rows.
One program per (b,oc,od,ceil(oh/4)), loops over up to 4 contiguous OW rows.
One program per (b,oc,od,ceil(oh/8)), loops over up to 8 contiguous OW rows.
One program per (b,oc,od,ceil(oh/16)), loops over up to 16 contiguous OW rows.
